headline: Airbnb restrictions will solve only a fraction of Prague's housing crisis, analysis shows
summary: A new analysis compared the number of apartments offered on Airbnb in Prague with the size of the city's housing deficit. It found that Airbnb restrictions would solve only a fraction of the shortage.
why: Short-term rental rules affect residential housing supply and property values in major European cities, which matters for real estate investors.
